title: Icons drawn inside a slot that holds only them leave with that slot instead of failing the write
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A JA Boxing trainer card's linked and hidden icons become hides with their links-only holder; the hide stage empties the holder and carries each icon.
A holder the plan writes, a slot with words, and a dropped page are unchanged.

tests: a slot of links only is told from a slot with words
every icon the plan decides in a slot of icons only is hidden, and the slot with them; the card's other decisions stay
a holder the plan writes, a block with no such icon and a dropped page stay as the plan left them
the hide stage empties the holder and carries its icons with it, where before each icon had no way out
